name: Rokae (Shandong) Robotics Group Inc.
summary: Rokae (Shandong) Robotics Group Inc. engages in the design, development, manufacturing, and commercialization of intelligent robots and robotic solutions in China. The company offers a robotic application ecosystem, comprising industrial robots, flexible collaborative robots, embodied intelligent robots, and related robotic solutions. It develops Rokae robotic technology platform primarily comprising forward design and validation system, xCore control system, and the ROKAE+ ecosystem platform to offer a diverse range of robots and process packages for a wide variety of application scenarios.
